svg.title: bin/make -j 2 on the cut-down build: each target waits for its count of unfinished prerequisites to fall to 0, then joins the queue
svg.text: bin/make -j 2, nothing built yet: the number on each target is how many of its needs are not finished

g.title: Each target waits for as many targets as it needs. The 5 sources need none: they are ready, and queued in the search's order.
The sources come off the queue up to date (files with no rule), so each is finished at once. Every object's count falls to 0: freq.o, util.o, table.o, sort.o join the queue.
Two may run at once: freq.o and util.o come off the front of the queue and start.
freq.o finishes: freq now waits for 1. table.o starts in the free slot.
util.o finishes: libds.a now waits for 1. sort.o starts in the free slot.
table.o finishes: libds.a reaches 0. libds.a joins the queue. libds.a starts in the free slot.
sort.o finishes: sort now waits for 1; libds.a finishes: freq reaches 0, sort reaches 0. freq and sort join the queue. freq and sort start in the free slots.
freq finishes: all now waits for 1; sort finishes: all reaches 0. all joins the queue; it is phony, with no recipe, so it is finished as soon as it comes off, and the build is done.
